'''Steven Yeager''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[August 2000 Fairmont tournament]] on 5 August 2000, according to John Tatta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1088">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-06-fairmont-wv-8-5-00d1088/ fairmont-wv-8-5-00], DeckTech (John "Artoo-Detoo" Tatta, 6 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-06-fairmont-wv-8-5-00d1088/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
